header.title: The battle for capital hill midterm edition
header.author: RobOS Tabletop Studio
header.description: Enter the Capitol halls in Midterm Elections: Battle for the Hill. Storm the Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room, and Oval Office—defeat the partisan bosses and the three Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted), expose the bipartisan slush fund, and reach the Capitol exit stairs!

turnStart.text: Uhh... let me be clear... When you roll the dice... in this dungeon... you are not merely rolling plastic... you are rolling... the audacity... of hope.
Uhh... folks... Michelle and I... were talking just the other day... about how even in a dark corridor... filled with goblins... hope... always finds a way.
Uhh... make no mistake... The arc of the moral dungeon... is long... but it bends... toward hope... and... uhh... a modest middle-class tax cut.
Uhh... look... we can disagree... without being disagreeable... even when a two-headed hydra... is trying... to bite your head off... with hope.
Uhh... let me say this... Change does not roll in... on the wheels of inevitability... It rolls in... on two red six-sided dice... of hope.
Uhh... there is not a liberal dungeon... and a conservative dungeon... There is the United Dungeon... of America... and... uhh... we are lost in it.
Uhh... yes we can... step onto this next stone square... with the fierce urgency... of now... and the quiet dignity... of hope.
Uhh... if you like your broadsword... you can keep... your broadsword... Period... Full stop... Because that... is the promise... of hope.

turnStart.text: They're eating the dogs! Sleepy Crooked Joe Biden — I really don't know what he said!
Threatening me with 400 years in prison for possessing my own presidential papers, which just about every other president has done!
A crooked New York state judge just ruled that I have to pay a fine of $355 million for having built a perfect company! It's a disgrace — I don't even know who this woman is!
I do like my garbage truck! Crooked Joe Biden finally said what he and Kamala really think of our supporters — he called them garbage, no way!
Well, I took two tests — cognitive tests. I aced them, both of them! He took none! I'd like to see him take one, just one, a real easy one!
I won two regular club championships! To do that, you have to be quite smart and hit the ball a long way. And I do it! He can't hit a ball 50 yards!
She did things that nobody would ever think of! Now she wants to do transgender operations on illegal aliens that are in prison!
Well, we need Greenland for national security purposes! People really don't even know if Denmark has any legal right to it, but if they do, they should give it up!

turnStart.text: We live in a world today where there are several hundred million people starving to death — they're starving to death right now!
In some of the largest cities in America, 50% of the kids are not graduating high school! The cost of college education is zooming up, so you have to be a wealthy person to send your kid to college!
In Sweden, they've had socialist governments for decades — 80 or 90% of the people voting, strong labor unions, and a health care system guaranteeing health care to all people!
They say we're getting tough on crime — if you want to get tough on crime, let's deal with the causes of crime! Let's demand that every man, woman, and child have a decent standard of living!
We have an approach to campaign financing which allows wealthy people and major corporations to buy and sell politicians! The rich get richer and the poor get poorer!
The chief executive officers are seeing their salaries soar, and the gap between the rich and the poor grows wider! Ten million Americans are unemployed!
We give huge tax breaks to the wealthy and you have two million people sleeping out on the street! Billions of dollars in obsolete weapon systems, and five million children who are hungry!
Workers in the United States today are working significantly longer hours, taking less vacation time — is there any wonder why so many millions of Americans feel stressed out?!

midterm-election.title: The battle for capital hill midterm edition

quests.title: Quest 1: Battle for the Hill
quests.briefing: Enter the Capitol halls in Midterm Elections: Battle for the Hill. Storm the Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room, and Oval Office—defeat the partisan bosses and the three Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, and Brownsted), expose the bipartisan slush fund, and reach the Capitol exit stairs!
primaryGoals: Defeat the Capitol Bosses & Hydra Bosses (Talarixon, El-Rogers, Brownsted, Katie Zacharia, Mitch McConnell, and Drunk JD Vance & Kamala Harris).
Storm the Capitol chambers (Briefing Room, Committee Chamber, War Room & Oval Office) and expose the bipartisan slush fund.
Lead all surviving heroes safely to the Capitol Exit Stairs at [14, 2].
